name: Criquet
why: The 1970s golf shirt rebuilt — four-button placket, removable collar stays, and a refusal to look like performance kit.
origin: Billy Nachman and Hobson Brown, Austin, 2010. They met at an all-boys school in New York and started the brand hunting for a lost inherited golf shirt; Luke Wilson is a part-owner.
opview: Their own stated ambition: to be Patagonia's brother — the brother that prefers the golf course to the highest peaks, and the bar stool to the bivouac.

onething.n: verified ✓ — the shirt the brand was built on; collection page

notes.golf: Golf is the whole premise rather than a category the brand entered — the Players Shirt is a 1970s tour polo rebuilt, and everything else follows from it.
notes.cotton: Founded on a 100% organic cotton claim. The current Players Shirt is described as 100% premium pima, and the line now includes a 57/43 organic-cotton and polyester performance version — the organic premise has softened as the range grew. Recorded because the two claims are not the same.

cities: No US stores — the Austin S 1st St clubhouse, the brand's only store, is closed · DTC · golf and resort shops
